title: Add retry-aware webhook delivery for failed automation jobs
description: Build deterministic retry scheduling with clear tests. Steps to reproduce: webhook delivery fails once and never retries. Expected behavior: failed deliveries retry with backoff. Actual behavior: the event is dropped.

title: Improve CLI config validation and JSON error output
description: The CLI should explain invalid config fields and return structured JSON for automation. Includes reproduction steps and does not require special hardware.

title: Investigate iOS-only rendering issue with paid workspace
description: Requires paid workspace and iOS hardware. The issue is valuable but has special setup requirements and several competing PRs.
